entries.sourceStatus: 2019 recruitment General Candidates Series C (exam 12 January 2020). All 140 original-numbered questions now have readable stems and A–D choices. Q114–116 were visually transcribed from the public ExamSiri-linked Series C scan, printed page 26, and align with final-key positions B, C and D; TNUSRB-hosted original-PDF certification remains pending. Q46 and Q121 are provisionally scored from documented cross-series corroboration; Q47 and comparison figures Q84/Q95/Q103 remain explicitly ungraded. Q96 original A–D Venn diagrams were not supplied, so previously displayed editorial verbal substitutes are now replaced by clearly missing-diagram labels and Q96 is ungraded. A separate Series D reproduction corroborates the Q97 three-row/two-column study layout, not the original C printed image. Eight source-review disputes plus three ALL-key positions are excluded from marks. 125 editorial or secondary-scan-reviewed Tamil study texts plus eight already-Tamil source-numbered entries support Tamil/Both modes; seven intentionally ambiguous English-source positions remain untranslated. No departmental-candidate material is used.

All six are readable study exercises but deliberately ungraded. Q9 duplicate option and Q120 diagram without printed instruction remain ungraded. 16 editorial Tamil study items: Q11–20 (10 general questions) plus Q99–104 (six graph questions with method-only bilingual explanations). These are NOT certified original TNUSRB bilingual texts; the remainder still lacks complete bilingual coverage. Official original TNUSRB booklet and final key not independently certified; no departmental question mixing. The Q99–104 learning methods show the graph-comparison formulas, 2015 coaching PDF page provenance and Q100 choice C conflict (original-numbered archive 1996 versus separately renumbered secondary 1995), without inferring official point values or correct answers. Exam scoring unchanged.
